Keep Pocket Quran on your phone

Android: open this site in Chrome, then choose Install app or Add to Home screen from its menu.

iPhone: open in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

The Quran text and research tools work offline after the app reports that offline preparation is complete. Notes are stored on this device; export a backup before changing devices.
